findings.subject: shop.newsletter
findings.message: Every role, including roles created later, can read personal data in shop.newsletter.

findings.subject: shop.export_customers()
findings.message: shop.export_customers() runs with the rights of shop_owner and doesn't set search_path: whoever can run it may be able to make it run their own code.

findings.subject: shop_owner
findings.message: New tables that shop_owner creates in schema shop are granted SELECT to PUBLIC.

findings.subject: shop_reporting
findings.message: shop_reporting is a member of pg_read_all_data: it reaches every table.

findings.subject: shop.count_orders()
findings.message: shop.count_orders() runs with the rights of shop_owner, who can read 10 personal data columns; it can be run by every role (PUBLIC).

findings.subject: shop.export_customers()
findings.message: shop.export_customers() runs with the rights of shop_owner, who can read 10 personal data columns; it can be run by shop_etl.
